description: An ACK-ONLY received in IDLE(CONNECTED), before any ARQ data has flowed, draws a WARNING with reason 3.
note: Link setup as cas/make-called-accept: at 2000 the peer 0.0.1.3 calls with an Ed4 PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST, our accept goes out at 52000, and when that transmission ends at 57550 the link is made with the 16-bit family (B-0213, B-0142): window edges at their initial values (C-0782, C-0787), and cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 runs (B-0215). Nothing has been sent or received by ARQ yet, so the peer's DTS state here is IDLE(CONNECTED). At 61000 an ACK-ONLY from the peer (RX LWE 0, no bitmap, EOT 10). Table C-18 answers an ACK-ONLY in IDLE(CONNECTED) with a WARNING, reason 3 (invalid D_PDU for the current state), D_WARNING_TRANSMITTED to the CAS, and a move to DATA(CONNECTED) (C-0659, C-0733); the ACK-ONLY itself is not processed. The burst ends at 62000: csma.vdcd_end to 66000, LBT rule 1, contention 12000 ms, and at 78000 the WARNING (type 15) goes: received frame type 10, reason 3 (C-0378, C-0380); 12 bytes, one block, EOT 10. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133), so a DATA-ONLY is 19 bytes plus its segment, an ACK-ONLY 15 bytes plus its bitmap and a DATA-ACK 22 bytes plus bitmap and segment. dts.ack_wait_ms 60000. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000 ms (K-0080). Transmissions are zero filled: fill is P4-3's.
